system.name: PAPI
system.one_liner: a PIM-enabled heterogeneous computing system that dynamically schedules LLM decoding kernels across GPU-like PUs and two types of PIM units based on runtime parallelism

components.name: Host CPU
components.role: sends instructions to the high-performance processor and the disaggregated Attn-PIM devices

components.name: High-Speed Interconnect
components.role: connects components inside the high-performance processor

components.name: Processing Units (PUs)
components.role: compute-bound kernel execution units, e.g. GPU tensor cores

components.name: FC-PIM
components.role: PIM memory unit with relatively high computation capability, catering to FC kernels

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: hardware scheduler that monitors runtime parallelization changes and dynamically offloads FC kernels

components.name: Interconnect
components.role: connects the high-performance processor to the disaggregated Attn-PIM units

components.name: Attn-PIM
components.role: physically separate, memory-capacity-optimized PIM units dedicated to the always memory-bound attention kernel

components.name: Bank Groups (BGs)
components.role: memory bank groups inside FC-PIM/Attn-PIM devices

components.name: FPU
components.role: floating-point unit performing PIM computation within a bank

components.name: RLP/TLP/Reschedule/RESULT table
components.role: worked example of runtime request- and token-level parallelism counters driving the PU/PIM reallocation decision

content.key_idea: PAPI is a heterogeneous architecture pairing a high-performance processor (PUs + FC-PIM + scheduler) with disaggregated Attn-PIM units, whose scheduler monitors request- and token-level parallelism at runtime to dynamically place FC kernels on the best-fit hardware while attention kernels always run on Attn-PIM.

summary: PAPI is a PIM-enabled heterogeneous architecture that dynamically routes LLM decoding kernels to the most suitable hardware. Figure 5(a) shows the overall system: a host CPU drives a high-performance processor containing GPU-like Processing Units (PUs), an FC-PIM memory unit, and a hardware Scheduler, all connected via a high-speed interconnect, plus physically disaggregated Attn-PIM units reached over a separate interconnect. Panels (b) and (c) zoom into the FC-PIM and Attn-PIM bank-group/FPU internals. Panel (d) walks through a worked example of the scheduler's dynamic mapping: per-token RLP and TLP values are combined to estimate arithmetic intensity and decide, token by token, whether to reschedule the FC kernel between PUs and FC-PIM while attention always runs on Attn-PIM. Distinct flat colors mark PUs, FC-PIM, Attn-PIM, and the scheduler.
summary_zh: 图5展示PAPI异构系统：(a) 主机CPU驱动含GPU式处理单元、FC-PIM及调度器的高性能处理器，并通过互连连接独立的Attn-PIM单元；(b)(c) 展示FC-PIM与Attn-PIM内部的存储体组与FPU结构；(d) 给出基于RLP/TLP动态判断并重新调度FC核到PU或PIM的实例。
